mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods following a positive HOUST signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >100k in 1 month and UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a shift towards more efficient production, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies become more profitable.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases by >0.5% in 3 months and INDPRO increases by >0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
